title: Why Universal Consciousness is Kept Sleeping Within Us (1976-01-23)
description:
Struggling with unresolved emotions or false spiritual paths? Discover the actual experience of Kundalini awakening that proves God's existence on your own nervous system.

This public program details the subtle system, explaining how specific deities govern our chakras and evolution. Shri Mataji unifies religious figures like Mohammed, Jesus, and Krishna as part of one tree, warns against false gurus, and answers deep questions on the purpose of human creation.

Key Topics:
• ⚡ Kundalini as the loving Mother and the role of Mooladhara (Ganesha) in protecting Her protocol
• 🌙 Unity of religions: Understanding Mohammed, Nanak, and Jesus as part of the same divine tree
• 💭 The 3 stages of growth: Thoughtless Awareness, Doubtless Awareness, and complete God Realization
• 🔬 Healing psychosomatic issues by becoming a 'Sakshi' (Witness) - includes personal story of curing a heart condition
• 💬 Q&A insights on why consciousness was dormant (egg shell analogy) and the spiritual root of overpopulation

“Kundalini is your Mother... She knows your problems. She loves you. She is the only Mother you have and She has been with you for ages for many lives.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Audience Questions:
• Why is universal consciousness kept sleeping in human beings?
• What is the idea of Atmadhyan (Self-attention)?
• Why is there so much misery and overpopulation in the world?

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• How to tell if a spiritual guru is genuine or false?
• What is the connection between Islam and Hinduism spiritually?
• How to cure physical diseases through meditation?

Shri Mataji explains that all great incarnations come from one tree. How does seeing the unity between figures like Mohammed, Jesus, and Krishna change your perspective on religion?

---

Archival audio recording of H.H. Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi at Sahaja Yoga Public Program 1976 in New Delhi (India).
